title: Batch CLI tests do not protect batch option semantics
reasoning: The batch success test records `output_dir` but only asserts URL order, and it never passes or verifies provider, transcriber, no-resume, screenshot interval, OCR height, or display flags. The failure test covers default continue-after-error behavior but not `--stop-on-error`. A regression that drops user-selected batch options or ignores stop-on-error would still pass, which is risky because batch mode can multiply runtime and API cost.
recommendation: Assert the full kwargs passed to `_run_single_url` in batch mode and add a stop-on-error test that proves the second URL is not processed after the first failure.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: Existing batch tests focus on report contents and URL sequencing, not the option-forwarding contract or stop-on-error branch.
suggestedRegressionTest: Invoke `cli` with `--provider openai --transcriber cpp --whisper-model small --screenshot-interval 45 --ocr-video-height 720 --no-resume --no-summary --stop-on-error` and assert `_run_single_url` receives those values and stops after the failing first URL.
